notes:
**Joint release with keen-backend 0.30.0** — the collaboration release: work on projects together, one place to say things, one Inbox, and reminders that sync both ways.

## Work together on a project

- **Comments on shared tasks** — threaded conversations right on the task, with replies, edits, and deletes that respect everyone's copy.
- **@-mentions everywhere you write** — comments, progress notes, Quick Log, and quick capture. Mentions render as names, click one to open the person's card, and mentioning someone on a shared project notifies them.
- **Assign tasks** — ⌥A or the assignee chip picks from the project's people; the assignee sees it in their Inbox.
- **My Profile & rosters** — set your display name and avatar color in Settings → Collaboration; every shared project shows who's in, and edits show who made them.
- **Hand off a contact** — when the person behind a contact changes, one gesture revokes their access everywhere and mints fresh invites for their replacement — telling you first how much assigned work is at stake.

## Notes & Comments, one place

- **One composer on every task** — notes stay in your journal, comments go to the project, and the segmented control makes the choice per post. Solo tasks are simply your notes.
- **Everything you say lands in your journal** — comments are echoed into that day's Daily Log automatically.
- **A face-lift for every composer** — mode-colored outline, buttons below the field, and a journal tint that tells you at a glance when what you write is private.

## Unified Inbox

- **Every notification, durable** — mentions, assignments, reminders, workflow output, and share activity land in a browsable Inbox (⌥⌘6) with filters, archive, and "Mark all read", instead of a toast you might have missed.
- **Rows take you to the thing** — a comment notification opens the task scrolled to the conversation.

## Apple Reminders, both ways

- **Complete anywhere** — tick a Keen reminder off on your iPhone and the Keen task completes within seconds, and vice versa.
- **Your phone can capture tasks** — reminders you create in a Keen list are imported as tasks, and each project gets its own `Keen · {Project}` list.

## Chat & the assistant

- **Floating chat window** (⌘⌥⌃C) — always on top, full chat experience, and it knows which view you're looking at.
- **The assistant can take you there** — ask for a task, a project, or a page and it navigates the app for you; it can also build and refine your Summary sections.

## Summary dashboard

- **Filters you can see** — every rule shows a live match count as you type, with drag-to-reorder, grouping with visible connectors, and section duplication. Plus a Projects section type and a searchable, filterable section list.

## Help & What's New

- **A Help hub** — Ask Keen, take the tour, and Report a problem (pre-filled GitHub issue carrying only your version and a scrubbed route).
- **This dialog** — feature highlights up top, full release history below, shown once after every update.

## Fixes & polish

- Photos attached to chat now actually reach the model; oversized images degrade gracefully with a named warning.
- Completing a task fades the row out (with an opt-in celebration), and finishing a task silences its reminder.
- Progress notes no longer lose multi-line edits or drafts; clearing a reminder date no longer deletes the Apple reminder.
- Restores are fast again, confirmation prompts can't be spent on the wrong item, and dozens more correctness and privacy fixes.

## Install

| Platform | Artifact |
|---|---|
| Apple Silicon | `Keen_0.30.0_aarch64.dmg` |
| Intel Mac | `Keen_0.30.0_x64.dmg` |

Existing installs: **Keen → Check for Updates** or Settings → Updates.

Managed Keen Cloud users: after updating the desktop app, use **Update your server** in Settings → Managed Servers (or the compatibility prompt) once the new backend image is available.
